en.headline: deTour 2026 design festival opens at PMQ with free admission through 29 November
en.dek: Organised by PMQ under the theme Better, Not Perfect, the festival shows 14 works and runs 11 a.m. to 8 p.m. from Saturday, with shorter hours today.
body: deTour 2026, Hong Kong’s annual design festival organised by PMQ, opened today at 35 Aberdeen Street in Central and runs until 29 November.

The festival is themed Better, Not Perfect: Prototypes for Tomorrow, with curator-at-large Shin Wong. It brings together 14 works by local, mainland and international creators across speculative tools, adaptive materials, social design and immersive experiences.
Admission is free. Hours are 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. today and 11 a.m. to 8 p.m. from 21 to 29 November. A pop-up shop, workshops, dialogues and guided tours are also part of the programme.
PMQ said the festival is supported by the Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency.

zh.headline: deTour 2026設計節於元創方開幕 免費入場至11月29日
zh.dek: 由元創方主辦，主題「不完美，更美好」，展出14件作品；今日開放至下午3時，明日起至晚上8時。
body: 香港年度設計盛事deTour 2026由元創方主辦，今日於中環鴨巴甸街35號開幕，展期至11月29日。
本屆以「BETTER, NOT PERFECT 不完美，更美好：Prototypes for Tomorrow」為主題，總策展人為黃馨，匯聚本地、內地及海外創作者共14件作品，涵蓋推想工具、適應物料、社會設計及沉浸體驗。
免費入場。今日開放時間為上午11時至下午3時，21至29日則為上午11時至晚上8時。現場設快閃選物店，並有工作坊、設計對話及導賞團。
元創方表示，活動獲文創產業發展處資助。
